testimonials.name: Jack C.
testimonials.quote: T & F Electric has done my electrical work for years. They're the only one I rely on in Dunnellon. Very prompt, great service, fair price.

testimonials.name: Alan G.
testimonials.quote: Our company went through several electricians before we found T & F Electric. Now, we can finally stop looking for a company that always responds quickly, sends experienced professionals and can handle any problem, including replacing worn-out cables.

testimonials.name: Charles V.
testimonials.quote: Arrived on time and completed all work as requested.

testimonials.name: Joe N.
testimonials.quote: They kept their appointment and were on time. I was impressed with their professionalism as well as their knowledge of their electrical trade.

testimonials.name: Karen W.
testimonials.quote: Very nice young man installed the ceiling fans for me and I would recommend him to others.

testimonials.name: James E.
testimonials.quote: Upon contacting T&F Electric, the President of the Company came out in a timely manner to inspect the job site and review the requirements for doing the job. Within 24 hours, I had a quote in hand. They arrived at the time they were supposed to and completed the job in a timely manner. They even asked if we had a vacuum cleaner they could use to clean up the work area. They are an excellent company who I would strongly recommend.

testimonials.name: Leslie B.
testimonials.quote: Easy to work with, professional, and you can't beat the price!

testimonials.name: Elaine M.
testimonials.quote: They responded by phone while I was still on line. Got the supplies needed and completed the job the following day. Fair pricing and fast service. Very satisfied.
